text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH - inference-gateway 5xx spike. Affected: hosted-api. Escalation: eng-oncall-primary. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD123456
maria: I'm primary for the next 4h, taking this. I'll start with Grafana to confirm dashboards. :wave:
josh: I'm secondary. If you need PD escalation privileges, I can ack/assign.
maria: Quick check - I can't open the "inference-gateway" Grafana dashboard (403). I also don't have the AWS assume role to view logs in account redwood-prod.
li: @maria I'm in the middle of a deploy but can grant you temporary grafana:view. @josh can you confirm PD ops role for @maria?
josh: I can add her to the PD schedule for ack rights. Maria, can you try to login to PD and call the incident API? If that fails, I'll ack from my phone.
maria: PD login works, but the incident page shows 'no escalate' button disabled. Likely missing escalation policy membership.
ops-bot: (automated) Incident timeline: error-rate up at 1781234550, 5xx rate 18% over threshold for 2m. Related alerts: gateway-5xx, gateway-latency.
sanjay: I'm going to check autoscaler and LB health. If we need to reroute, I can flip the canary route to model-variant-b.
maria: Runbook step 1: confirm PD escalation rights and docs https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-gateway. Step 2: check Grafana panels: /d/inference/overview
maria: For AWS logs: run `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodOncallReadOnly --role-session-name oncall` and then `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/infra/inference-gateway --start-time <ts> --filter-pattern "ERROR"`
josh: I'm granting grafana:view and adding @maria to PD escalation policy. LMK when you can ack.
maria: Acked the PD incident at 1781234568. Investigating correlated model OOMs on shard 2.
li: Noted a gap: 02:00-03:00 UTC tonight no backup oncall (we're light on coverage). Can we arrange a temp shift swap? @sanjay can you cover that hour?
sanjay: I can cover 02:00-02:45 UTC but not the whole hour. @josh can you take 02:45-03:00?
josh: I can cover 02:45-03:15. We'll mark the gap as covered.
maria: Mitigation: scaling inference-gateway replicas from 6 -> 12 for 30m, enabling prefix cache for the high-traffic route. Applying now.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Action executed: HPA scale to 12 triggered at 1781234575 by maria.
li: Confirmed Grafana panel loaded after view grant. Maria, you should now see error traces and the 5xx spike tied to model shard 2 OOM.
maria: Found heap OOM from model shard 2 at 1781234579. Rolling back recent model-quantization change on canary.
josh: On PD: ensured escalation membership, verified ack rights. Also set the incident's assigned_to to maria.
maria: Closing loop: initial mitigations applied, latency decreasing. I'll update the incident postmortem template and add runbook notes about PD membership checks.
li: Added a short checklist to runbook: 1) Verify PD escalate, 2) Grafana view, 3) AWS assume-role, 4) Coverage for 02:00-03:00 UTC.
maria: Thanks all. I'll keep monitoring for another 30m, then hand off to @josh for overnight.
josh: I'll take over at 1781234595. Please ping if anything else.
maria: Handoff done. :thumbsup:
